description: Centrally maintained operation equivalence candidates for benchmark authoring. equivalent lists operations with substantially the same primary runtime effect; alternatives lists operations that can achieve a similar analytical effect when their params can be derived in the runtime-facing format. Context-dependent or non-derivable alternatives should be labeled manually in individual instances.

bar.clickCategory.note: clickCategory and selectCategory share the category-selection runtime path. filterCategories can isolate the same explicitly selected categories when field and values are known.

bar.selectCategory.note: selectCategory and clickCategory share the category-selection runtime path. filterCategories can isolate the same explicitly selected categories when field and values are known.

bar.filterCategories.note: Filtering can be scored against category selection only when the filtered categories and field are explicit. Exclusion-style filters require manual labeling.

scatter.brushRegion.note: brushRegion and selectRegion share the region-selection parameter shape.

scatter.selectRegion.note: selectRegion and brushRegion share the region-selection parameter shape.

heatmap.filterCells.note: Both operations target one explicit x/y cell when xField, yField, xValue, and yValue are present.

heatmap.selectCell.note: Both operations target one explicit x/y cell when xField, yField, xValue, and yValue are present.

heatmap.selectSubmatrix.note: All operations target x/y heatmap regions. Params are generated only when xValues and/or yValues can be emitted directly.

heatmap.highlightRegion.note: All operations target x/y heatmap regions. Params are generated only when xValues and/or yValues can be emitted directly.

heatmap.filterCellsByRegion.note: All operations target x/y heatmap regions. Scalar xValue/yValue params are normalized to xValues/yValues when deriving selection or highlight alternatives.

heatmap.thresholdMask.note: Both operations use the same value-range params when minValue and/or maxValue are present.

heatmap.highlightRegionByValue.note: Both operations use the same value-range params when minValue and/or maxValue are present.

line.selectSeries.note: Series selection can be mapped to focus/bold params when field and values are explicit.

line.focusLines.note: Focus lines can be mapped to select/bold params when lines and lineField are explicit.

line.boldLines.note: Bold lines can be mapped to select/focus params when lineNames and lineField are explicit.
